verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no AI-generated insights or suggestions inside Moneybird. The MCP server, CLI and API let users connect external AI clients such as Claude or ChatGPT to their data, which is an adjacent channel rather than in-product AI insights. The duplicate-contact endpoint is not described as AI-driven.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
